verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the Connect API reference index, which lists webhook event delivery ('Digits sends this JSON request body to your configured webhook endpoint'), confirming Digits pushes events to a configured endpoint. Nothing else in the pack describes how subscriptions work, so the capability is confirmed but only in a single thin mention. Missing for 10: documented event types, subscription management (API or UI registration and filtering), signature verification, retry and delivery guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
